goal: Persist Journal add/edit/delete with an account-scoped durable outbox, no false saved acknowledgment, retry on explicit action/reopen and no resurrection from stale cloud reads.
successCriteria: Single journal envelope atomically stores entries, tombstones and pending operations after local acknowledgment.
Failed disk writes do not update the UI or claim saved; remote failures retain durable retryable mutations.
Queued revisions cannot let an older cloud ACK overwrite a newer edit/delete; closed account scope cannot write or update the next account.
Legacy namespaced Journal/hidden IDs migrate without reading ambiguous global caches; manual and Astrology saves use the same path.
TypeScript and meaningful race/restart/offline/disk-failure tests pass; cloud E2E/native evidence remain separate gated acceptance.
Independent QA dedupe/failure/merge findings closed with meaningful regression tests.
untouchedSurfaces: Server handler is owned by a separate R07 backend child with fresh scoped preflight.
No schema/migration, live publish/deploy, Admin, payment or account-deletion changes.
Legacy global storage is never adopted; existing private account namespace and scope cancellation remain canonical.

impact.entryPoint: Save insight from Tarot/chat/daily/Astrology, Journal mood/note/delete and sync retry banner.
impact.dataWrite: Account-scoped nilaza.journalState.v1 envelope stores entries, tombstones and pending upsert/delete revisions. Namespaced legacy journal/hiddenJournalIds are read only for initial migration; no global account mixing.
impact.backendContract: POST /journal/entries retains upsert input; additive operation=delete with localId. Client accepts synced only with matching acknowledged local ID/operation for delete and a real remote ID for upsert. Old server failures keep pending work.
impact.adminVisibility: No private Journal contents in Admin or telemetry; only status/sourceType counts.
impact.privacySafety: Verified backend auth required for cloud adapter; no provider keys, no private history in error logs, closed session cancels work, durable tombstones prevent deleted entries resurrecting.
impact.observability: Saved UI means acknowledged local persistence; synced label means acknowledged server. Pending failures show retry with no raw notes in events.
impact.rollback: Retain old namespaced legacy keys; envelope is additive v1. Reverting app must not restore stale legacy entries: export/restore current envelope through reviewed compatibility procedure; do not remove envelope/tombstones.

canonicalContracts: AccountScope and createAccountStorage namespace/strict completion write are unchanged.
JournalEntry and server journal_entries unique(user_id,local_id)/RLS remain; no schema needed.
JournalState v1 is one canonical local envelope; exact revision is acknowledged, older responses never replace newer pending state.
